class ElectricityBill:
    def __init__(self):
        self.__customerName = ""
        self.__unitsConsumed = 0
        self.__ratePerUnit = 5.0
        self.__totalBill = 0.0
    
    def setDetails(self, name, units):
        self.__customerName = name
        self.__unitsConsumed = units
    
    def calculateBill(self, rate=5.0):
        self.__ratePerUnit = rate
        self.__totalBill = self.__unitsConsumed * self.__ratePerUnit
    
    def display(self):
        print(f"Customer Name: {self.__customerName}")
        print(f"Units Consumed: {self.__unitsConsumed}")
        print(f"Rate per Unit: {self.__ratePerUnit:.2f}")
        print(f"Total Bill: {self.__totalBill:.2f}")


def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    name = data[0]
    units = int(data[1])
    rate = float(data[2]) if len(data) > 2 else 0.0
    
    if rate == 0:
        rate = 5.0
    
    bill = ElectricityBill()
    bill.setDetails(name, units)
    bill.calculateBill(rate)
    bill.display()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
